notes: Costs a lot. Scholarships exist for some Research Scholars programs but the scholarship page did not list Bioengineering. Email precollege@ucsd.edu with questions.
name: UC San Diego Bioengineering Research Scholars
org: UC San Diego Department of Bioengineering and Division of Extended Studies
city: La Jolla, San Diego, CA (live online)
what_you_do: Take live online bioengineering courses with a loaner lab kit. Start with an intro course, then a research workshop, then plan and carry out your own project with a university lab.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12. Entry is by application. The intro course (BE-BOAT) comes first.
pay_detail: Tuition $2,700 for the BE-BOAT intro course. Other course prices are on the course pages.
duration: About 7 weeks (Winter 2027 intro course: Jan 9 to Feb 27, 2027)
deadline_text: Winter 2027 application deadline Dec 18, 2026, with a last call through Jan 3, 2027. Space is limited and may fill sooner.
how_to_apply: Apply online. You hear back 7 to 10 business days later. Payment is due within 2 weeks of acceptance.
